author: Itthiporn Wongtang

title: Most well designed habit tracker
body:
Actually understands how to get you to stick and not stick to a habit.  The limit to the amount of habits you can track is a good thing.  The integration with health is smart.  One of my favorite features are the smart notifications that learns your behavior and the ability to set the period of time of when an unfinished habit appears as a badge notification so that habits you can no longer achieve that day isn't on the app all day.

Overall, very smartly designed in terms of what to put in and what not to.

My only frustration is the inability to set a health habit to automatically track the time I wake up.  Right now you can only track the length of sleep.  Thought this would be a common habiy.  ;)

Thanks for making this app to help us be better versions ofnourselves!
